findings.rationale: The tf_chain_ingress_role fixture declares an aws_security_group.jump resource whose ingress rule permits tcp port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0, exposing SSH to the entire internet.
The tf_chain_ingress_role fixture defines aws_iam_role.escalation with a permissive trust policy coupled by aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.escalation, allowing any AWS principal to assume the role.

The connectivity.json manifest in tf_chain_ingress_role shows edge sg-jump forwarding traffic into role-escalate via sts:AssumeRole, forming an end-to-end chain from internet-facing ingress to identity escalation.
The tf_iam_open fixture grants Statement[0] unrestricted actions across all resources, and tf_s3_public_access configures a public-read ACL, together forming an identity-to-data-exfiltration chain.
